snippet.title: Shutter Evidence Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
"Shutter Evidence" wishlist now on Steam®
 Only you can uncover the truth hidden within the darkness. Glide into the crime scene with your drone, find the keys, open the doors, and photograph the evidence. Be careful — if the perpetrators notice you, your drone could take serious damage.
